More and more developers don't read our docs or click through our dashboard. Their coding agent does.   Improve the system prompts, tool definitions and agent instructions that power our in-dashboard agent and onboarding flows.

  Start with one product and then roll what works across every product.
* ****Use AI tools as a core part of how you work,****
  and help the rest of engineering build faster with agents.
